name: Beef Cottage Pie with Mash

components.name: Beef Cottage Pie

ingredients.name: Beef stock used instead of wine

steps: Boil raw potato cubes until tender; drain and mash while hot with butter, milk, parmesan and salt.
Soften the diced vegetables and garlic in oil, then add the ground beef and cook until brown and crumbly.
Stir in flour and tomato paste before gradually adding the stock, thyme and Worcestershire. Simmer until the meat gravy thickens.
Fold peas through the filling, transfer to a baking dish and flatten gently. Spoon mashed potato over it, spreading to the edge.
Score the mash with a fork and bake at 200 C for around 25-30 minutes until top is golden and filling bubbles.
Let stand for several minutes before portioning. Cool quickly and freeze later-week portions.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Beef is deliberately distinct from the lamb shepherd’s pie; same cooking architecture but different meat and topping. Alcohol-free stock substitution.
Planning: SECONDARY STOVETOP: mince gravy and mashed potatoes cooked separately.
Freezer: pie freezes and reheats well
Dietary: Contains dairy, wheat and Worcestershire (may contain fish).
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
